extended-v-sit-hold.label: High V: straight legs at least 75°, hold 5s, lower
extended-v-sit-hold.camera: Side-oblique full-body view keeps the upright torso, fixed grips and both straight together legs visible at the 75-degree landmark. Entry and exit pass through L-sit without recoil.

assisted-one-arm-parallette-balance.camera: Front-oblique view shows the supporting locked arm, fully raised free hand and straight straddle on each side. Both grips return before each separate grounded exit; floor reset/rest separates the sides. The coach chooses a comfortable straddle width; the drawing does not prescribe an angle.
assisted-one-arm-parallette-balance.label: Coach supports pelvis; free hand clear, 3s each side

Both grips return before each separate grounded exit; floor reset/rest separates the sides. The coach chooses a comfortable straddle width; the drawing does not prescribe an angle.
one-arm-parallette-handstand.label: Coach present, no contact; free hand clear, 3s each side

repeated-straddle-press-to-handstand.label: Two straddle presses; 2s tops, 3s floor reset
repeated-straddle-press-to-handstand.camera: Front-oblique straddle view shows two complete grounded-start ascents with fixed grips and straight elbows/knees, two settled tops and an actual three-second stationary grounded reset. Lowering is deliberately authored between ascents; playback never reverses the entire guide.

repeated-pike-press-to-handstand.label: Two pike presses; 2s tops, 3s floor reset
repeated-pike-press-to-handstand.camera: Side-oblique together-leg pike view shows two complete grounded-start ascents with fixed grips and straight elbows/knees, two settled tops and an actual three-second stationary grounded reset. Lowering is deliberately authored between ascents; playback never reverses the entire guide.
